question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Inferior
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3) Senior**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inferior"** refers to something of lower quality, rank, or importance. (निम्न, कम महत्व का)

 
 
• **Example:** The products made of cheap materials are often considered inferior to premium-quality items.
 
 
 
• **"Senior"** refers to someone of higher rank, age, or importance, and is the opposite of "inferior." (वरिष्ठ, उच्च पदस्थ)
 
 
• **Example:** She was promoted to a senior position due to her hard work and dedication.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **"inferior"** is **"senior."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3) Senior**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Permit** (अनुमति देना): To allow something or give authorization for something to happen.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher did not permit the students to leave early.
 
 
 
• **Exterior** (बाहरी): Referring to the outer surface or appearance of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The exterior of the house was beautifully painted in white.
 
 
 
• **Unfair** (अन्यायपूर्ण): Not based on justice or equality; unjust or biased.
 
 
• **Example:** It was unfair of him to blame her for the mistake.
